provenance.captured: Granola transcript 40453f62-4f91-40d8-a4aa-3880e66c31ee, 'Todd x Zach // 1-1', 2026-09-15 13:30 EDT. This was a landing/handoff call driven by Zach's Friday surgery; ~30% build substance, ~70% personal (basement flooding, gutters, surgery/pain-management, kids). provenance.load_bearing_quote: I want to make sure you're able to drive where we've landed here. I don't anticipate it, but you never know.

opportunity.note: GREEN on the handoff itself - mechanics are understood by both sides, Todd has edit access + Copilot can modify flows, and a follow-up walkthrough is locked for tomorrow (Wed 2026-09-16) 2:00pm. Held short of a clean seal by two real open edges: (1) the sandbox→production Sugar cutover is untested in prod, and (2) Todd never gave a crisp read on priority / time-sensitivity or on what the 'logical transition' after Zach steps back actually is (clean handoff vs a retained phase-2). Warmth is very high; warmth is not a commitment to prioritize or fund phase-2.

beliefs.claim: This build needs Zach present to operate and go live - it doesn't survive a handoff.
beliefs.evidence: Todd has edit access to both Tidio and Zapier; the Zapier Copilot can modify branch logic on request; the flows and dedup/append zaps are documented and ARCS authored the connecting spec. Zach: 'God forbid something happens, I want to make sure you're able to drive where we've landed.'

beliefs.claim: The geo email mis-routing (~50%) must be fully solved before the plane can land.
beliefs.evidence: Todd chose the pragmatic path instead: route ALL mis-routed geo emails to Bill and let volume force the fix later. Todd: 'those others will just go to Bill. He'll probably get so bogged down with them that he'll just be like, all right, let's just figure this out.' Deliberate deferral, not an unresolved gap.

beliefs.claim: Go-live is a risky big-bang cutover.
beliefs.evidence: It resolved to a discrete, low-drama checklist: swap the Zapier→Sugar connector from the sandbox (connection 65663180 = prlresinstest) to the production instance, add the lead_source object into the live Sugar account, and install the Tidio WordPress plugin on the live site with the same credentials. Zach: 'all you'll have to do is just install the WordPress plugin on the live site and enter the same Tidio credentials... it should just work.'

beliefs.claim: Todd holds this as a high-priority, time-sensitive workstream.
beliefs.evidence: Unconfirmed - this is the load-bearing open question. Zach asked directly ('I don't know how high on the priority list this is for you, or how time sensitive') and got no crisp answer; ~70% of the call drifted to personal topics. Todd's engagement was genuine and he agreed to tomorrow, but priority and the shape of the 'logical transition' were never pinned.

insights.title: The handoff is real; the prod cutover is the only untested edge
insights.text: Everything Zach built runs against the sandbox and the Tidio staging plugin. The single genuine unknown is whether the sandbox behavior replicates when the connector is repointed to production Sugar and the lead_source object is added live. Tomorrow's walkthrough should either exercise that path or explicitly flag it as the one step deferred to a real prod window.

insights.title: Priority was asked and dodged - don't infer it from warmth
insights.text: Todd shared a lot of personal life (a strong-relationship signal) but never answered how time-sensitive PRL considers this. The correct read is 'unknown', not 'high because he was warm.' Tomorrow's call should get a plain answer to: is this a clean handoff-and-done, or does PRL want a retained phase-2 (personas, SEM funnel activation, analytics/conversion, prettier emails)?

insights.title: The Bill-routing punt is a deliberate design choice
insights.text: Sending all mis-routed geo emails to Bill until volume forces a better rule is Todd's call, made explicitly. Book it as an intentional interim, not a defect - but note it: if Bill gets 'bogged down' and nobody revisits, the routing quality quietly degrades and there's no owner assigned to the eventual fix.

next_steps.text: Before tomorrow 2pm (~2 hrs of work): finish the teed-up Tidio items - append the full Tidio chat conversation (not just the lead) into the assigned ticket, and wire the spec-code / competitor cross-reference so the ticket refers to the specific tech sheet. Prep the end-to-end walkthrough and consider a screen recording.

Tomorrow (Wed 2026-09-16) 2:00pm: run the full flow with Todd, optionally record it, optionally demo the Shash-set-up instance to a close partner to surface edge cases. Then re-run /recoil-close on THAT call - it is the true loop-closer, since this call left priority + transition open.

Go-live checklist requiring PRL-side prod access: repoint the Zapier→Sugar connector from sandbox (65663180) to the production Sugar instance, and add the lead_source object into the live Sugar account. Do NOT do this against prod until the sandbox flow is walked through and accepted.

Get a plain answer from Todd on (a) how time-sensitive PRL considers this and (b) the 'logical transition': clean handoff vs retained phase-2 (personas per landing page, SEM-page stubs activation, analytics/conversion, prettier rep/lead confirmation emails). This is the P4 belief that stays OPEN until answered.
Surgery Friday 2026-09-19, uncertain post-op bandwidth. Land the walkthrough + any prod-cutover support (or an explicit deferral) before Friday; assume near-zero availability for 1-2 weeks after.

p: This was a warm, personal call; the Forge guards against a warm call being read as a fully-closed engagement. GROUNDED = forced by a transcript line. INFERENCE = a reasonable read. The single most important ruling is that Todd's PRIORITY is INFERENCE-at-best (actually unconfirmed), and must not be upgraded to GROUNDED by the call's warmth.

p: The highest-information event tomorrow is watching Todd operate a flow unaided: if he can, the handoff is genuinely bomb-proof against Zach's post-op absence; if he can't, better to learn it now than after a botched prod cutover with real leads on the line.

Lossless test (no jargon, to Todd): 'Everything's built and documented so you can run it yourself; tomorrow I'll walk you through it live and record it, and the only real step left is flipping it from the test setup to your live site - which we shouldn't do until you've seen it work.' Holds intact.
